verdict.rationale: MailerLite documents a public RESTful API with API-key machine-to-machine authentication, date-based version pinning via the X-Version header, batch requests, and resource endpoints for campaigns, webhooks, and e-commerce data, plus official SDKs and an llms.txt index that returned HTTP 200. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Push or pull data from our RESTful API.
API keys are a quick way to implement machine-to-machine authentication without any direct inputs from a human beyond initial setup.
To lock down the API version, provide the current date at the time of implementation through `X-Version` header.
Draft, schedule, send, and cancel email campaigns, plus retrieve campaign reports and link clicks.
Bundle up to 50 API calls into a single batch request to stay within MailerLite's rate limits.
